# 金液還丹印證圖詩

**Base edition:** CK-KZ

## Authors / Editors
- DZJY  金液還丹印證圖詩

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

*Diagrammed and Versified Verifications of the Golden-Liquid Returning Elixir*

base teaching transmitted by [白玉蟾](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%99%BD%E7%8E%89%E8%9F%BE) (Bái Yùchán, 1194–1229); narrated and versified by [彭耜](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%BD%AD%E8%80%9C) (Péng Sì, *hào* 龍眉子 Lóngméizǐ); annotated by **涵蟾子** (Hánchánzǐ); dated **宋嘉定戊寅 = 1218** (Sòng Jiādìng 11)

A 20-chapter Southern-Sòng *nèidān* manual organised as a series of diagrams and verses (*tú shī* 圖詩) — nine chapters on the *outer* aspect (*wài fǎ xiàng* 外法象) of elixir-making (本原 / 乾坤 / 鼎器 / 鉛汞 / 和合 / 真土 / 採取 / 制度 / 輔佐), nine chapters on the *inner* aspect (*nèi fǎ xiàng* 内法象) of nourishing the elixir (服丹 / 九鼎 / 進火 / 退火 / 抽添 / 沐浴 / 金液 / 抱元 / 朝元), with two further chapters of warning. The work is the principal didactic compendium of the Bái Yùchán → Péng Sì transmission and uses graphic-and-versified pedagogy — characteristic of the late-Sòng Nánzōng — to make the *jīndān* curriculum systematically accessible.

**Abstract**

The principal didactic compendium of the late Southern-Sòng **Nánzōng** Daoist inner-alchemy, transmitted from Bái Yùchán to his disciple Péng Sì (*hào* Lóngméizǐ), authored by Péng on the basis of his master's oral instruction and dated 1218 (Sòng Jiādìng 11). The work is one of the most well-organised exposition-handbooks of the Nánzōng tradition, with its 9 + 9 + 2 division providing a complete graphical-and-versified curriculum — and an *ad-hoc* commentary added later by **涵蟾子** (Hánchánzǐ — most likely a Yuán-Míng-era commentator). The DZJY recension is the basis for the ongoing transmission.

For the broader Bái Yùchán → Péng Sì lineage see [白玉蟾](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%99%BD%E7%8E%89%E8%9F%BE) and [彭耜](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%BD%AD%E8%80%9C).
